hypotheses.title: Market-Neutralized Volatility & Super Alpha Expansion: Replicating the EXCELLENT Breakthrough
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Leverages the breakthrough discovery that market-wide cross-sectional ranking (group_rank(..., market)) with market neutralization unleashes cross-sector relative value, surging Fitness to 2.02 (EXCELLENT) and dropping self-correlation against subindustry-neutral portfolio holdings to 0.6159. Deploys this market-wide architecture across four distinct volatility surfaces: (1) 1-Year Put Volatility Downside Skew in Market Scope. (2) 2-Year Put Volatility Downside Skew in Market Scope. (3) 3-Year LEAP Call Volatility Term Structure in Market Scope. (4) Market-Neutralized Super Alpha combining 1-Year Call Volatility and 252d FX Translation Hedging.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if market-wide options demand reflects market beta sentiment rather than true risk premia.
